:::{#def-signal}
#### Signal (statistical sense)

In statistical modeling,
the **signal** is the deterministic part of the model.
For mean-based models,
the signal is the model-implied [mean function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/model-validation.html#def-mean-function),
for example $\E{Y \mid X}$ (or $\E{Y}$ when there are no [covariates](Intro-to-GLMs.qmd#def-predictors)).
:::
